dpcs_rule_scope: fixed noise-scale adaptation; original paper exact L unavailable
stop_formula: sqrt(mean_source norm(delta_gamma)^2/norm(old_gamma)^2)<0.001; undefined initial-zero denominator does not stop
basis: native orthonormal IFFT, no SVD whitening, projected with I-VrVr*; matching frequency transport
noise_implementation: independent CN(0,sigma^2), sigma=0.1*norm(Yclean)/sqrt(Yclean.size); no sample-norm rescaling; differs from unspecified author implementation
CUDA_engineering_selection: One public-state full-step replay: strided4 vs packed16;2.915x wall gain, exactly matching outputs; old paid partial preserved; fresh uniform five-arm comparison before GT scoring
physical_validation: air and both stage endpoints only; no additional physical corrector; no GT endpoint selection
forward_model: R1 dyadic point DDA with CM+RR self, not author cell-integration implementation
fine_support_restriction: data generation only, exact zero-current elimination for known chi=0; never inverse
